lit.\u0027¿En qué parte del cloroplasto ocur: "In which part of the chloroplast does the light phase occur?"
lit.\u0027¿Qué estructura da rigidez a la cé: "Which structure gives rigidity to the plant cell and is made of cellulose?"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEl \u003cb\u003enúcle:
"

The nucleus stores the DNA (chromatin), with its nucleolus and its pores. The rough reticulum and the ribosomes make proteins; the smooth reticulum synthesizes lipids. Note that the vacuole has displaced the nucleus toward the wall.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLa \u003cb\u003epared:
"

The cellulose cell wall (the crossed mesh) surrounds the plasma membrane and gives it rigidity. Between neighboring cells there is a pectin middle lamella. The plasmodesmata cross the wall and connect the cytoplasms.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLa \u003cb\u003evacuo:
"

The central vacuole occupies much of the cell. Filled with water and solutes, it pushes the cytoplasm against the wall and generates the turgor pressure that keeps the tissue firm. It also stores substances and degrades waste.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLa pared, la vacuola:
"

The wall, the vacuole and the chloroplasts distinguish the plant cell. Switch to Functions to color by system, turn off the Cutaway to see the closed cell or click on any component.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLas \u003cb\u003emito:
"

The mitochondria produce ATP by cellular respiration, day and night. The peroxisomes collaborate with chloroplasts and mitochondria in photorespiration and degrade H₂O₂ with catalase.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLos \u003cb\u003eclor:
"

The chloroplasts capture light with chlorophyll. In the thylakoids (stacked in grana) ATP, NADPH and O₂ are produced; in the stroma the Calvin cycle converts CO₂ into sugars. The amyloplasts store the starch.

The yellow arrows represent the incident light.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLos \u003cb\u003edict:
"

The dictyosomes (plant Golgi) synthesize the wall polysaccharides (hemicellulose, pectin) and package them in vesicles that fuse with the membrane (exocytosis) and the wall grows. During division they form the cell plate.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eLos \u003cb\u003emicr:
"

The cortical microtubules form hoops under the membrane and guide the deposition of cellulose. Actin drives cytoplasmic streaming. Plants lack centrioles and typical intermediate filaments.

"
lit.\u0027«Funciones» pinta cada componente: "“Functions” paints each component according to its system."
lit.\u0027Abre «Comparar» y anota qué orgánu: 'Open the comparison tab and note which organelles it shares with the animal cell.'
lit.\u0027Al llenarse de agua presiona el ci: "As it fills with water it presses the cytoplasm against the wall (turgor) and stores nutrients and waste."
lit.\u0027Al poner una célula vegetal en agu: "When a plant cell is placed in distilled water, it does not burst because…"
lit.\u0027Almacenan almidón, la reserva ener: "They store starch, the plant's energy reserve; they are abundant in tubers, roots and seeds."
lit.\u0027Ambas son eucariontes con núcleo,: "Both are eukaryotes with nucleus, reticula, Golgi, mitochondria and cytoskeleton. What is specific to the plant cell:"
lit.\u0027Apaga el corte para ver la célula: 'Turn the cutaway off to see the closed cell, then on again to find the central vacuole.'
lit.\u0027canales que comunican células veci: "channels that connect neighboring cells through the wall"
lit.\u0027Capa rica en pectinas compartida p: "Pectin-rich layer shared by two neighboring cells, preceding the primary walls."
lit.\u0027Cementa las células contiguas y ma: "It cements adjacent cells and holds the tissue together."
lit.\u0027Conectan los citoplasmas de célula: "They connect the cytoplasms of adjacent cells (symplast)."
lit.\u0027Da forma y rigidez, resiste la pre: "It gives shape and rigidity, resists turgor pressure (prevents the cell from bursting when it absorbs water), protects against pathogens and guides growth. It is permeable to water and ions."
lit.\u0027Dos membranas rodean al estroma, d: "Two membranes surround the stroma, where flattened sacs called thylakoids float, stacked in grana. They contain chlorophyll, circular DNA and ribosomes of their own."
lit.\u0027Empuja al núcleo y a los demás org: "It pushes the nucleus and the other organelles toward the periphery, leaving only a thin layer of cytoplasm."
lit.\u0027En las plantas hay muchos dictioso: "In plants there are many small dispersed dictyosomes; they synthesize wall polysaccharides (hemicellulose and pectin) and send them in vesicles."
lit.\u0027Está pegada a la pared celular, qu: "It is pressed against the cell wall, which contains the osmotic pressure."
lit.\u0027Forma solo una capa delgada entre: "It forms only a thin layer between the membrane and the vacuole."
lit.\u0027Forman anillos corticales bajo la: "They form cortical rings under the membrane that guide the deposition of the cellulose microfibrils."
lit.\u0027Generan la corriente citoplasmátic: "They generate cytoplasmic streaming (cyclosis), which drags organelles such as chloroplasts."
lit.\u0027Gran compartimiento rodeado por el: "Large compartment surrounded by the tonoplast, full of vacuolar sap: water, ions, sugars, organic acids, pigments (anthocyanins) and hydrolytic enzymes."
lit.\u0027Haz clic en la pared, la vacuola y: 'Click the wall, the vacuole and a chloroplast: these three structures set the plant cell apart.'
lit.\u0027La actina y la miosina arrastran l: "Actin and myosin drag the organelles through the cytoplasm."
lit.\u0027La célula vegetal NO tiene típicam: "The plant cell typically does NOT have…"
lit.\u0027La clorofila de las membranas tila: "The chlorophyll of the thylakoid membranes captures the light; the Calvin cycle occurs in the stroma."
lit.\u0027La función principal de la vacuola: "The main function of the central vacuole is…"
lit.\u0027La luz (flechas amarillas en la le: "Light (yellow arrows in the lesson) reaches the chloroplasts, which are located near the wall."
lit.\u0027La madera es, sobre todo, pared ce: "Wood is mostly lignified secondary cell wall of dead cells."
lit.\u0027La papa es rica en almidón porque: "The potato is rich in starch because its cells are full of amyloplasts."
lit.\u0027La pared celular de celulosa rodea: "The cellulose cell wall surrounds the membrane and supports the cell."
lit.\u0027La pared rígida resiste la presión: "The rigid wall resists the pressure generated by the entry of water."
lit.\u0027La vacuola central cumple funcione: "The central vacuole performs functions that in the animal cell are shared by the lysosomes."
lit.\u0027La vacuola genera \u003cb\u003etur: "The vacuole generates turgor and the wall contains it: together they give firmness to tissues."
lit.\u0027Las pectinas de esta capa son las: "The pectins of this layer are what make jams gel."
lit.\u0027Las plantas con flores organizan e: "Flowering plants organize the spindle without centrioles."
lit.\u0027Las plantas también respiran: de n: "Plants also respire: at night and in organs without light the mitochondria produce the ATP; by day they cooperate with the chloroplasts."
lit.\u0027Las plantas tienen \u003cb\u003emi: "Plants have mitochondria in addition to chloroplasts: they respire and photosynthesize."
lit.\u0027Lo que distingue a la célula veget: "What distinguishes the plant cell: cell wall, central vacuole and chloroplasts."
lit.\u0027Los \u003cb\u003ecloroplastos\u003: "Chloroplasts and mitochondria have a double membrane and their own DNA and ribosomes (endosymbiotic origin)."
lit.\u0027Los cloroplastos (y la pared y la: "Chloroplasts (and the wall and the large vacuole) characterize the plant cell."
lit.\u0027Mantiene la turgencia (presión int: "It maintains turgor (internal pressure), stores nutrients and waste, contains pigments and degrades components (it partly equals the lysosomes)."
lit.\u0027Microfibrillas de celulosa embebid: "Cellulose microfibrils embedded in hemicellulose, pectins and proteins. The primary wall is flexible; in some cells a secondary wall with lignin is added."
lit.\u0027Muchos virus vegetales se propagan: "Many plant viruses spread using these channels."
lit.\u0027muestra u oculta sistemas, etiquet: "shows or hides systems, labels and the cutaway."
lit.\u0027Participan en la fotorrespiración: "They take part in photorespiration together with chloroplasts and mitochondria."
lit.\u0027Permiten el paso de agua, iones, a: "They allow the passage of water, ions, sugars, RNA and proteins between cells: they form the “symplast”. They play a role similar to that of animal gap junctions."
lit.\u0027Poros que atraviesan la pared y co: "Pores that cross the wall and connect the cytoplasms of neighboring cells; through their center passes the desmotubule, an extension of the endoplasmic reticulum."
lit.\u0027quita la mitad frontal de la pared: "removes the front half of the wall, membrane and vacuole to see the inside; turn it off to see the closed cell."
lit.\u0027Realizan la fotosíntesis: en los t: "They carry out photosynthesis: in the thylakoids the light phase captures energy and produces ATP, NADPH and O₂; in the stroma the Calvin cycle fixes CO₂ and makes sugars."
lit.\u0027Rodea a la membrana plasmática; la: "It surrounds the plasma membrane; the microfibrils are seen as the crossed mesh."
lit.\u0027selecciona un componente, lo resal: "selects a component, highlights it and dims the rest; press it again to clear the selection."
lit.\u0027Sigue la lección con el reproducto: "Follow the lesson with the player below or explore freely: rotate by dragging, zoom with the wheel and click on any component to see its fact sheet."
lit.\u0027Su origen sería una cianobacteria: "Their origin would be an endosymbiotic cyanobacterium; that is why they have their own DNA and ribosomes."
lit.\u0027Suele quedar desplazado a la perif: "It is usually displaced to the periphery by the large vacuole."
lit.\u0027tabla con las diferencias frente a: "table with the differences from the animal cell."
lit.\u0027Transportan material de la pared h: "They carry wall material to the outside and form the cell plate when the cell divides."
lit.\u0027Un orgánulo presente en la célula: "An organelle present in the plant cell and absent in the animal one is…"
lit.\u0027Una planta se marchita cuando sus: "A plant wilts when its vacuoles lose water and the cells lose turgor."
